units.rpm_drop: flywheel rev/min lost during one shot (coasting wheel)

label: predicted (uncalibrated model; no measurements exist yet)
model: src/launcher.py simulate_shot: planar 1-D contact path, Coulomb stick/slip at wheel and top contact, linear N(delta), centripetal unloading of the wheel contact on a curved hood, rolling hysteresis c_rr, coasting flywheel, passive roller with bearing drag

ball_mass.prov: user/confirmed via HANDOFF s1-2: AndyMark am-5851_yellow lists 0.055 lb = 24.95 g (https://andymark.com/products/biobuzz-scoring-elements?variant=47194281148588); weigh samples

ball_radius.prov: confirmed nominal 2.8 in / 71 mm diameter (HANDOFF s1, s2); pieces vary

ball_kI.prov: derived/assumed: I_b = kI m R^2. Thin shell 2/3 is the upper bound for a sphere with mass at the surface; uniform PE shell (rho~950 kg/m^3) holding 25 g at R=35.5 mm needs t~1.7-2.4 mm (perforations) -> thick-shell formula kI=0.4(1-q^5)/(1-q^3), q=1-t/R, gives 0.62-0.64; 0.55 covers ribs/thick bosses/non-sphericity. Uniform hole pattern does not change kI. MEASURE (bifilar/trifilar pendulum).

wheel_inertia.prov: assumed/derived: bare 98 mm wheel ~1.0e-4 (assumed: 50-250 g, k_w 0.4-0.8 -> 0.5e-4..4.8e-4) + one goBILDA steel flywheel 3628-0032-0082 (82 mm, 152 g, 1651 g cm^2 = 1.651e-4, confirmed https://www.gobilda.com/steel-flywheel-82mm-diameter-152g-1651-g-cm/). Motor rotor inertia not published (bounded <~1e-5, assumed, reflected x gear^2).

mu_wheel.prov: assumed: rubber/TPU tread on PE; MEASURE (incline/pull test)

mu_hood.prov: assumed: PTFE/UHMW ~0.05-0.15, polycarbonate/acrylic/HDPE ~0.2-0.4, rubber/grip-tape lined 0.6-1.0 against PE; MEASURE

delta.prov: user candidate 4 mm diametral compression (HANDOFF s2); swept 2-8 mm

k_n.prov: assumed: linear diametral stiffness of a 71 mm hollow perforated PE ball (no source found); N(4 mm) = 6-40 N. Real N(delta) is non-linear (shell buckling). MEASURE with plates + scale at 2/4/6/8 mm.

lam_radius.prov: assumed: r_c = R_b - lam*delta/2; lam=1 all squeeze in the ball split evenly, lam=0 rigid-radius rolling (flattened patch)

c_rr.prov: assumed: rolling-hysteresis lever arm / r_c (energy loss per metre = c_rr N); Brettle notes the ball 'is not a perfect spring' -> extra wheel slow-down

wrap_deg.prov: assumed: hood wrap angle about the wheel axis; shooter CAD not provided (HANDOFF s2)

v_in.prov: assumed: feed speed of the ball into the contact (indexer), no initial spin

roller_radius.prov: assumed: 1-4 in class passive top roller

roller_inertia.prov: assumed: 48 mm compliant wheel ~25-40 g + shaft ~ 0.7-1.5e-5; light 1e-6; with an added flywheel up to ~2e-4

roller_tau_coulomb.prov: assumed: two small sealed ball bearings + seals; MEASURE by spin-down

shot_interval.prov: assumed: time between consecutive shots (roller coasts with bearing drag)

motor_gobilda_5203_1to1.prov: confirmed goBILDA 5203-2402-0001 page: 6000 rpm @12 V, 1.47 kg cm (=0.144 N m), 9.2 A stall (https://gobilda.com/5203-series-yellow-jacket-motor-1-1-ratio-24mm-length-8mm-rex-shaft-6000-rpm-3-3-5v-encoder); related 5202 tested free speed ~5400 rpm (vendor listing) -> real free speed lower

motor_rev_hdhex_bare.prov: confirmed REV docs HD Hex Motor: 6000 rpm, 0.105 N m, 8.5 A @12 V (https://docs.revrobotics.com/duo-build/motion/motors/hd-hex-motor); UltraPlanetary 5:1 (5.23:1) 1147 rpm 0.55 N m (same page)

hood_ideal_brettle.note: derived: rigid, no slip at both contacts at exit, v_in=0, Brettle RPM drop with kI=0.63, I_w=2.65e-4; v=R_w*Omega_exit/2, omega=v/R_b, S=1

hood_nominal.note: mu_w 0.8, mu_hood 0.3 (polycarbonate-like), delta 4 mm, k_n 4 N/mm, wrap 90 deg

hood_soft_ball.note: low stiffness bound k_n 1.5 N/mm (N(4mm)=6 N)

hood_stiff_ball_8mm.note: high stiffness 10 N/mm and 8 mm squeeze (N=80 N)

roller_light_rest.note: light 48 mm roller (2e-6) from rest, mu_top 0.8

roller_nominal_rest.note: 48 mm roller I=1e-5 from rest, mu_top 0.8

roller_heavy_rest.note: 48 mm roller + flywheel I=2e-4 from rest

roller_nominal_steady.note: I=1e-5, 4th shot of a 0.5 s-interval burst (roller pre-spun by previous shots)

recovery_hood_nominal.note: derived: time for a goBILDA 5203 1:1 (6000 rpm, 0.144 N m @12 V, confirmed) at full voltage to restore the hood_nominal rpm_drop, I_w 2.65e-4, no current limit, no controller lag; inf = setpoint above the loaded free speed

motor_assist_bounds.note: hood_nominal; Brettle assumes coast; real velocity control lies between

roller.box: passive: I_t 1e-6..2e-4, R_t 12.5-50 mm, bearing 0..3e-3 N m, delta 4/8 mm, mu_top 0.8, k_n 4 N/mm; shots 1-3 of a 0.5 s burst (rest, then pre-spun)

roller_hypothetical_forward_prespin.note: NOT achievable by a passive roller in this model (the ball drags it backward); shows that S<1 needs the top surface moving forward

roller_fast_feed.note: light roller, ball fed with forward speed v_in and zero spin

hood_fast_feed_short_slick.note: S<1 from a fixed hood needs the ball to ENTER already moving (pre-accelerated, no spin) and leave before hood friction rolls it up (short wrap, low mu); not a recommended design, shows the limit
